detail.createPayoutHelp: Settles this partner's entire outstanding APPROVED commission balance into one payout batch, gated on their minimum payout threshold. For a STRIPE-method partner this executes a real Stripe Connect transfer to the account on file for this partner — never to any other account.

trigger.title: Start a reconciliation run
trigger.description: Scans recent jobs' financial records for discrepancies. This never changes any financial record — it only detects and records inconsistencies for review. A run can take a while for a large scope/limit; you can navigate away and check its status from the runs list.
trigger.startedDescription: {created, number} new, {reconfirmed, number} reconfirmed discrepancies so far.
trigger.failed: Could not start the reconciliation run

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.subtitle: Financial reconciliation runs and discrepancies across Payments, Commission, Tax, Invoicing, Payouts, Refunds, and Credit Notes.

overview.readOnlyNotice: Reconciliation is read-only with respect to every financial record it inspects — it only detects and records discrepancies here for manual review. Resolving a discrepancy never changes a Payment, Invoice, Payout, Refund, or Credit Note; it only closes this investigation.

discrepancies.title: Discrepancies
discrepancies.subtitle: Detected financial inconsistencies awaiting or already given a resolution.
discrepancies.emptyDescription: Try a different filter, or narrow the date range.

runs.subtitle: Every execution of the reconciliation engine, newest first.
runs.emptyDescription: Runs will appear here once the reconciliation engine executes.

runDetail.noDiscrepanciesDescription: This run completed without detecting any discrepancy.
runDetail.caption: Discrepancies for this run

resolve.title: Resolve this discrepancy
resolve.description: Marks this discrepancy resolved, attributed to your admin account. This does not undo or change any financial record — it only closes the investigation. This cannot be undone from this screen.
resolve.reasonTooShort: Please describe why this discrepancy is being resolved (at least 3 characters).
resolve.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Verified against the Stripe dashboard — this was a timing difference, both amounts now match.

discrepancyDetail.title: Discrepancy {id}…
discrepancyDetail.notResolved: This discrepancy has not been resolved yet.

form.title: Record a manual observation
form.intro: Capture a response from an AI system outside this application (per the query text below), then record what you objectively observed. This never contacts any AI system on your behalf.
form.evidenceExcerpt: Evidence excerpt (short, optional — never a full transcript)
